overall_design: Transcriptomic analysis of co-culture generated  lipid-associated macrophages (LAMs) and naive macrophages co-cultured with untreated hepatic cells (referred to as the Control, Ctrl group) by RNA sequencing (RNA-seq). There are six samples in the study which belonged to two groups, each groups contains three samples.
summary: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is characterized by profound remodeling of hepatic macrophages, including the emergence of lipid-associated macrophages (LAMs). However, the mechanisms through which LAMs promote fibrosis and their key molecular drivers remain elusive.
title: Transcriptomic analysis of co-culture generated lipid-associated macrophages (LAMs)
type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
